definitions.explanation: Two people in a romantic relationship. Used for dating couples and partners in general.

examples.japanese: あのカップルはいつも{一緒|いっしょ}にいる。
クリスマスイブは{多|おお}くのカップルがレストランで{食事|しょくじ}をする。
examples.english: Many couples dine at restaurants on Christmas Eve.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しくできたカフェには、{若|わか}いカップルがたくさん{来|き}ていた。
examples.english: Many young couples were coming to the newly opened café.

notes:
From English "couple." In Japanese, カップル specifically refers to romantic pairs, unlike English where "couple" can mean any pair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カップルで{行|い}く: to go as a couple
- {若|わか}いカップル: young couple
- カップル{向|む}け: for couples (marketing term)
- お{似合|にあ}いのカップル: a well-matched couple

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {恋人|こいびと}: lover, sweetheart (refers to one person in the relationship)
- ペア: pair (more general, not necessarily romantic)
- {夫婦|ふうふ}: married couple
